name.en: Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd.
name.zh: 四平市巨元瀚洋板式换热器有限公司

short_description.en: Heat exchange system solution provider and plate heat exchanger manufacturer covering detachable, semi-welded, fully welded, integrated-unit, and smart heating solutions.
short_description.zh: 面向可拆式、半焊式、全焊式、换热集成系统及智慧供热信息平台提供板式换热器和高效换热系统解决方案的制造商。

en: Siping Juyuan Hanyang Plate Heat Exchanger Co., Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary of THT Juyuan Group and positions itself as an integrated service provider for efficient heat exchange system solutions in China. The official company profile states that the company was founded in 1986.

The company covers an area of 165,000 square meters with a building area of more than 40,000 square meters. It lists annual capacity of 1,000,000 square meters of plate heat exchangers and 5,000 sets of system integration devices.

Juyuan Hanyang is listed by the official profile as a drafting or participating unit for plate heat exchanger and plate heat exchanger unit standards, a member of the National Boiler and Pressure Vessel Standardization Technical Committee, and a member of relevant American heat transfer and HVAC industry associations. The profile also lists civil nuclear safety equipment design and manufacturing licenses, plate heat exchanger safety and energy-saving registrations, pressure vessel design and manufacturing licenses, SCADA software copyright registration, ASME certification, AHRI certification, and quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management system certification.

The official profile describes an advanced plate heat exchanger production line, including uncoiling, leveling, shearing, laminating, four 10,000-ton press plate production lines with maximum press capacity of 50,000 tons, and large intelligent CNC equipment. Its product system includes detachable plate, semi-welded, fully welded, heat exchange integrated system, and smart heating information platform product groups, with more than 100 heat exchange product types.

According to the official profile, the company’s business reaches 31 countries and regions and 108 industries, and it has supplied more than 200,000 products and services to domestic and overseas customers across military, nuclear energy, biomass energy, power, petroleum, chemical, metallurgy, shipbuilding, central heating, air conditioning and refrigeration, food and beverage, seawater desalination, and related industries.
zh: 四平市巨元瀚洋板式换热器有限公司是 THT 巨元集团全资子公司，官网将其定位为国内高效换热系统解决方案集成服务商。官方企业介绍显示，公司始创于1986年。
公司占地面积16.5万平方米，建筑面积4万余平方米，年生产能力为板式换热器100万平方米、系统集成装置5000台套。

官网介绍显示，巨元瀚洋是板式换热器和板式换热机组相关国家标准的主要起草或参与单位，亦为全国锅炉压力容器标准化技术委员会委员单位，以及美国传热协会、美国空调供热制冷工业协会成员单位。官网列出其具备民用核安全设备设计制造许可证、板式热交换器产品安全注册证、板式热交换器节能注册证、D级压力容器设计制造许可证、SCADA自控系统软件著作权、ASME认证、AHRI认证及质量/环境/职业健康安全管理体系认证。
公司官网披露其拥有开卷、校平、剪切、层压生产线，4套万吨压机板片生产线（最大吨位5万吨），以及4200mm×1800mm整体下料机等智能数控制造装备。其产品体系包括可拆式板、半焊式、全焊式、换热集成系统及智慧供热信息平台5个产品群，形成100余种换热产品。
官网资料显示，公司业务覆盖全球31个国家和地区、108个行业，并持续为国内外客户提供20万余台套产品及服务，行业覆盖军工、核能、生物质能、电力、石油、化工、冶金、船舶、集中供热、空调制冷、食品饮料、海水淡化等领域。

en: Founded in 1986 with official profile capacity of 1,000,000 square meters of plate heat exchangers and 5,000 integrated-system units per year.
Current product system covers detachable, semi-welded, fully welded, integrated heat exchange systems, and smart heating information platforms.
Officially listed standard drafting and association roles across Chinese plate heat exchanger standards and heat transfer industry organizations.

Certification coverage includes civil nuclear safety equipment licenses, plate heat exchanger safety and energy-saving registrations, ASME, AHRI, pressure-vessel licenses, and management system certification.
Advanced production capability includes uncoiling, leveling, shearing, laminating lines, four 10,000-ton press lines with maximum 50,000-ton pressing capacity, and large CNC equipment.
Business coverage stated by the official profile reaches 31 countries and regions, 108 industries, and more than 200,000 supplied products and services.
zh: 始创于1986年，官网披露年产能为板式换热器100万平方米、系统集成装置5000台套。
当前产品体系覆盖可拆式、半焊式、全焊式、换热集成系统及智慧供热信息平台。
官网列出其参与板式换热器及换热机组相关标准起草，并拥有多项行业组织成员身份。
资质覆盖民用核安全设备许可证、板式换热器安全/节能注册、ASME、AHRI、压力容器许可及管理体系认证。
制造能力包括开卷校平剪切层压生产线、4套万吨压机板片生产线、最大5万吨压制能力及大型数控设备。
官网披露业务覆盖31个国家和地区、108个行业，并已提供20万余台套产品及服务。

name.en: Primary Energy Efficiency Plate Heat Exchanger
name.zh: 一级能效板式热交换器

short_description.en: Level-1 energy-efficiency plate heat exchanger series tested under China’s heat exchanger energy-efficiency evaluation rules.
short_description.zh: 依据中国换热器能效测试评价规则完成测试评价的一级能效板式热交换器系列。

full_description.en: The official product page states that after the release of TSG R0010-2019, Heat Exchanger Energy Efficiency Testing and Evaluation Rules, THT Juyuan had eight plate series tested and evaluated by the National Heat Exchange Product Quality Supervision and Inspection Center and meeting Level-1 energy-efficiency requirements for high-efficiency plate heat exchangers: Y5F, Y10B, P15B(H), Y15B, S15B-H, P15G-Z, Y20B, and P45A-H. The company also identifies itself as one of the drafting units of NB/T47004.1-2017 Plate Heat Exchanger.
full_description.zh: 官网产品页介绍，在 TSG R0010-2019《热交换器能效测试与评价规则》发布后，THT 巨元已有 Y5F、Y10B、P15B(H)、Y15B、S15B-H、P15G-Z、Y20B、P45A-H 共8个板型系列经国家换热产品质量监督检验中心测试评价，达到高效板式热交换器能效标准一级。官网同时说明，THT 巨元是 NB/T47004.1-2017《板式热交换器》国家行业标准起草单位之一。

en: Eight listed plate series meet Level-1 energy-efficiency requirements.
Officially connected with NB/T47004.1-2017 plate heat exchanger standard drafting.
The page highlights corrugation design and gasket fixing/sealing improvements for transfer efficiency and reliability.
zh: 官网列出8个板型系列达到一级能效要求。
与 NB/T47004.1-2017《板式热交换器》标准起草工作相关。
页面强调圆弧波峰设计和矩形卡扣垫片结构，以提升换热效率、固定和密封可靠性。

en.Level-1 Energy-Efficiency Plate Series: Y5F, Y10B, P15B(H), Y15B, S15B-H, P15G-Z, Y20B, P45A-H

en.title: What makes it different?
en.content: The official page presents the product as a Level-1 energy-efficiency plate heat exchanger family, supported by national testing and evaluation and by the company’s role in plate heat exchanger standard drafting.

zh.content: 官网将该系列定位为一级能效板式热交换器，核心依据是国家换热产品质量监督检验中心的测试评价，以及企业参与板式热交换器标准起草的背景。

short_description.en: Standardized heat exchange unit with modular configuration, standardized control program, and lower pressure-drop targets than the national reference values listed by THT.
short_description.zh: 采用配置、结构和控制程序标准化设计的换热机组，官网列示其压降指标低于对应国标参考值。

full_description.en: THT describes the standardized heat exchange unit as a product built from professional selection practice, standardized configuration, standardized structure, standardized control programs, modular production, and factory inspection. The product page compares THT targets with national reference values, including plate exchanger pressure drop of 40kPa versus 50kPa, primary-side unit pressure drop of 60kPa versus 100kPa, and secondary-side unit pressure drop of 80kPa versus 100kPa. It also emphasizes quick installation, direct start after piping and power connection, unmanned operation, and energy-efficiency analysis.
full_description.zh: 官网将标准化换热机组描述为基于专业选型、标准化配置、标准化结构、标准化控制程序、模块化装配生产和出厂检验形成的产品。页面列示 THT 巨元标准与国标对比：板换压降40kPa（国标50kPa）、机组一次侧压降60kPa（国标100kPa）、二次侧压降80kPa（国标100kPa），并强调接管接电后可直接启动、安装快捷、无人值守及能效分析功能。

en: Standardized configuration, structure, and control program.
Modular assembly and factory inspection support shorter delivery and easier installation.
Official comparison lists lower pressure-drop targets than the cited national reference values.
Supports unmanned operation and energy-efficiency analysis.
zh: 配置、结构和控制程序标准化。
模块化装配与出厂检验有助于缩短交付并简化安装。
官网列示的压降指标低于对应国标参考值。
支持无人值守和能耗分析功能。

en.Control: Standardized control program with energy-efficiency analysis

zh.控制: 标准化控制程序，含能耗分析功能

en.title: How is the unit delivered?
en.content: The official page describes standardized and modular assembly, automatic sizing and cutting, intelligent welding, surface treatment, module assembly, pressure debugging, and factory inspection.

zh.title: 官网如何描述制造交付？
zh.content: 页面列出标准化、模块化装配生产，以及自动定尺切割、智能焊接、喷砂除锈、静电喷涂、模块装配、压力调试和出厂检验。

en.meta_description: Standardized heat exchange unit with modular configuration, standardized control program, and lower pressure-drop targets than the national reference values listed by THT.

zh.meta_description: 采用配置、结构和控制程序标准化设计的换热机组，官网列示其压降指标低于对应国标参考值。

short_description.en: Semi-welded plate heat exchanger using laser welding and plate-pair welding processes for duties where one side requires welded sealing.
short_description.zh: 采用激光焊接和板对焊接工艺、适用于单侧介质需要焊接密封工况的半焊式板式热交换器。

full_description.en: The official page says THT uses advanced fiber-laser welding machines and modern laser welding technology for semi-welded plate heat exchangers. Compared with other welding methods, the page highlights a single-weld process, small heat-affected zone, low post-weld deformation, automatic inspection during welding, fast welding speed, and low residual-stress ratio. The page also states that the product has obtained B2-B3 level safety registration certification for welded plate heat exchangers.
full_description.zh: 官网介绍半焊式板式热交换器采用国际先进的光纤激光焊接设备和现代激光焊接技术。相较其他焊接方式，页面强调单焊缝工艺、热影响区小、焊后变形小、焊接过程自动检测、焊接速度快及残余应力较小等特点，并说明该产品取得国家焊接板式热交换器 B2-B3 级安全注册认证。

en: Laser welding process with small heat-affected zone and low deformation.
Automatic inspection during welding helps control weld quality.
Guide-plate mechanical tests can verify plate-pair welding quality.
Officially listed B2-B3 safety registration certification for welded plate heat exchangers.
zh: 激光焊接热影响区小、焊后变形小。
焊接过程中可自动检测，有助于控制焊缝质量。
导板可进行力学性能试验，用于验证板对焊接质量。
官网列出国家焊接板式热交换器 B2-B3 级安全注册认证。

en.Welding Method: Fiber laser welding and CNC seam welding
en.Safety Registration: B2-B3 level welded plate heat exchanger safety registration

zh.焊接方式: 光纤激光焊接、数控缝焊
zh.安全注册: 焊接板式热交换器 B2-B3 级安全注册

en.meta_description: Semi-welded plate heat exchanger using laser welding and plate-pair welding processes for duties where one side requires welded sealing.

zh.meta_description: 采用激光焊接和板对焊接工艺、适用于单侧介质需要焊接密封工况的半焊式板式热交换器。

short_description.en: Patented welded block heat exchanger combining plate heat exchanger efficiency with strong sealing, pressure, and temperature capability.
short_description.zh: 融合板式换热效率与焊接密封、耐温耐压能力的专利板框式热交换器。

full_description.en: The official page describes THT’s block heat exchanger as a patented product with independent intellectual property rights, patent number 200520127761.X, belonging to the welded plate heat exchanger category. It uses plates as heat transfer components and combines the advantages of plate heat exchangers and spiral plate heat exchangers. The page states that it follows NB/T47004-2009 and GB150-1998, and can also follow API662 and ASME according to user requirements.
full_description.zh: 官网将板框式热交换器描述为巨元具有自主知识产权的专利产品（专利号：200520127761.X），属于焊接板式热交换器。该产品以板片作为换热元件，融合板式换热器和螺旋板式换热器的优点。页面说明该系列严格执行 NB/T47004-2009 和 GB150-1998 标准，也可按用户要求执行 API662、ASME 等标准。

en: Patented product with independent intellectual property rights.
Combines high heat transfer efficiency, compact structure, high-temperature resistance, sealing performance, and reliability.
Automatic welding and weld-image tracking are used to control weld quality.
Compact block structure can reduce space and construction cost versus detachable plate heat exchangers.
zh: 具有自主知识产权的专利产品。
兼具高换热效率、结构紧凑、耐高温、密封性能和安全可靠性。
采用自动焊接设备及焊接图像自动跟踪控制焊缝质量。
板框式结构相较可拆式板换更紧凑，可节省空间和建设成本。

en.Standards: NB/T47004-2009; GB150-1998; API662 and ASME on request

en.meta_description: Patented welded block heat exchanger combining plate heat exchanger efficiency with strong sealing, pressure, and temperature capability.

zh.meta_description: 融合板式换热效率与焊接密封、耐温耐压能力的专利板框式热交换器。

short_description.en: Plate-shell and tube-plate heat exchanger platform using welded plate bundles and mature inspection procedures for special-duty applications.
short_description.zh: 采用焊接板束及成熟检验规程、面向特种工况的板（管）壳式换热器平台。

full_description.en: The official page explains that the plate is the core heat-transfer component of the plate-shell heat exchanger. THT lists plate structures including chocolate-shaped ripple, horizontal ripple, oblique ripple, and herringbone ripple forms. Plates are formed through one-piece pressing and then edge-cut by laser for consistent dimensions. After each single plate tube and plate bundle is welded, an air-tightness test of 0.6-0.7MPa is performed. The page states that part of the shell-type equipment can withstand 6.0MPa operating pressure and has been used in nuclear power, military, and other major equipment projects.
full_description.zh: 官网说明板片是板壳式换热器的换热核心元件，THT 巨元焊接式设备的板片形式包括巧克力状波纹结构、水平波纹、斜波纹和人字形波纹等。板片采用整体压制一次成形，并通过激光切割四周齐边以保证尺寸一致。每对单板管和板束整体焊接完成后均进行0.6-0.7MPa气密检测。页面还说明，板壳式部分设备可承受6.0MPa运行压力，并已应用于核电、军工等重要项目。

en: Multiple plate corrugation structures for different operating conditions.
One-piece plate pressing and laser edge cutting improve dimensional consistency.
Each welded plate tube and plate bundle receives air-tightness testing.
Part of the shell equipment can withstand 6.0MPa operating pressure.
zh: 多种板片结构可适配不同工况。
整体压制和激光齐边提高板片尺寸一致性。
每对单板管和板束整体焊接后进行气密检测。
部分板壳式设备可承受6.0MPa运行压力。

en.Plate Forms: Chocolate-shaped ripple, horizontal ripple, oblique ripple, herringbone ripple

zh.板片形式: 巧克力状波纹、水平波纹、斜波纹、人字形波纹

en.meta_description: Plate-shell and tube-plate heat exchanger platform using welded plate bundles and mature inspection procedures for special-duty applications.

zh.meta_description: 采用焊接板束及成熟检验规程、面向特种工况的板（管）壳式换热器平台。

name.en: Fully Welded Wide Channel Plate Heat Exchanger
name.zh: 全焊式宽通道板式热交换器

short_description.en: Fully welded wide-channel plate heat exchanger for solid-particle, fiber-suspension, and viscous-fluid duties.
short_description.zh: 面向含大量固体颗粒、纤维悬浮物及粘稠流体工况的全焊式宽通道板式热交换器。

full_description.en: The official page says the fully welded wide channel plate heat exchanger is created for special customer needs and is particularly suitable for media containing large amounts of solid particles, fiber suspensions, and viscous fluids in metallurgy, papermaking, sugar, alcohol, chemical engineering, and sewage treatment processes. The product uses large single plates, with maximum length over 10,000mm and width of 1,200mm. Plate spacing columns are laser welded, long welds are seam welded, outer-end welds use automatic argon arc welding, and each plate pair receives 0.6-0.7MPa air-tightness testing after welding.
full_description.zh: 官网介绍，全焊式宽通道板式换热器是专为客户特殊需求开发的产品，特别适用于冶金、造纸、制糖、酒精、化工、污水处理等行业中处理含大量固体颗粒、纤维悬浮物和粘稠状流体的介质。该产品板片单板尺寸大，最大长度可达10000mm以上，宽度1200mm；板片定距柱采用激光焊，纵向长焊缝采用缝焊，外侧端部焊缝采用自动氩弧焊，每件板片对焊接完成后均进行0.6-0.7MPa气密检测。

en: Wide-channel design for solids, fibers, and viscous media.
Large single plate size supports demanding industrial processes.
Laser welding, seam welding, and automatic argon arc welding are used for different weld positions.
Each plate pair receives air-tightness testing after welding.
zh: 宽通道结构适用于固体颗粒、纤维和高黏度介质。
大尺寸单板适合复杂工业流程。
定距柱、长焊缝和端部焊缝采用不同自动化焊接工艺。
每件板片对焊后进行气密检测。

en.Air-Tightness Test: 0.6-0.7MPa after each plate pair is welded

name.en: Special Heat Exchanger for Waste Heat Recovery
name.zh: 余热回收专用特种热交换器

short_description.en: Welded plate heat exchanger solution for industrial wastewater, exhaust gas, flue gas, sewage, and other waste-heat recovery systems.
short_description.zh: 面向工业废水、废气、烟气、原生污水等余热回收系统的焊接板式特种热交换器。

full_description.en: The official page lists THT welded plate heat exchangers for heat exchangers, air coolers, air preheaters, compressor interstage coolers, ammonia coolers, crude oil and residual-oil exchangers, power-plant air cooling, plate evaporative air cooling, MDEA solution heat exchange, and plate economizers. It says the waste-heat recovery welded plate heat exchanger is mainly used for industrial wastewater and exhaust gas, multi-effect evaporation tail gas in corn deep-processing, urban raw sewage, and heat recovery from flue gas generated by various fuels. The page emphasizes reliable sealing, long-cycle operation, low leakage and clogging risk, convenient maintenance and cleaning, and low maintenance cost.
full_description.zh: 官网列出 THT 巨元焊接板式热交换器可用于换热器、空冷器、空气预热器、压缩机级间冷却器、氨冷器、原油与渣油换热器、电厂空冷、板式蒸发空冷、MDEA溶液换热、板式省煤器等。余热回收焊接板式换热器主要应用于工业废水、废气，玉米深加工行业多效蒸发尾气，城市原生污水，以及各种燃料产生烟气等热量回收利用系统。页面强调其密封可靠，可长周期运行，不易泄漏和堵塞，检修清洗方便快捷，检修费用低。

en: Targets industrial wastewater, exhaust gas, flue gas, sewage, and evaporative tail-gas heat recovery.
Reliable welded sealing for long-cycle operation.
Designed to reduce leakage and clogging risk.
Convenient maintenance and cleaning with low maintenance cost.

full_description.en: The official page lists brazed plate heat exchanger product features as high turbulence and very high heat transfer performance, high temperature and pressure resistance, and small size with light weight. It explains that the brazing filler is heated from solid to liquid, fills gaps formed by plate support points through wetting and capillary action, and forms the connection between different materials after cooling. The page lists copper-based solder foil, nickel-based solder paste, and iron-based solder paste.
full_description.zh: 官网钎焊板式换热器页面列出产品特性：高度紊流、传热性能极高，耐温耐压能力高，体积小、重量轻。工作原理为通过加热将固态钎料变为液态，利用其在母材表面的润湿和毛细作用填入板片支撑点形成的间隙中，冷却后形成异种材料间的连接。页面列出铜基钎料（箔片）、镍基钎料（膏料）和铁基钎料（膏料）。
